[![modrinth.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HiWord9/RPRenames/extra/links/modrinth.png)](https://www.modrinth.com/mod/rp-renames)[![curseforge.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HiWord9/RPRenames/extra/links/curseforge.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/rp-renames)[![github.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HiWord9/RPRenames/extra/links/github.png)](https://github.com/HiWord9/RPRenames)[![discord.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HiWord9/RPRenames/extra/links/discord.png)](https://discord.gg/3Q699k7qHr)| ---|--- **在游戏中直接在铁砧菜单里查看你资源包的所有 CIT 和 CEM 改名！** 这是一款客户端模组，能帮助你在使用资源包时为工具或其他物品找到合适的自定义名称。它会列出每种新纹理所需的所有可能名称，你只需点击即可让你的物品焕然一新。 ![CIT list](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84eb41c031698153b87e4c63961f72342007a6e7.png) ![Previews!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/hvqcuDMT/images/713c175aecc1eaffa7a715bdef732e30c11bcce1.png) 创造模式标签页！|CEM 支持！ ---|--- ![Creative Tab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/hvqcuDMT/images/c449b37cc335faeaa049de72f736fac23670c55e.png)|![cem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/hvqcuDMT/images/e0d9636c217069d9af43733828e306a0f4d8d383.png) ![Built-in Resource Packs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/hvqcuDMT/images/9bb2bceef6b3eb0f255f0fd7308de58bec433e86.png) 全新的角色扮演体验！你不再需要去资源包官网或其他地方在庞大的改名列表中苦苦寻找一个名称，现在它就在你的 Minecraft 中！
